reviews.author: Lee Owen
reviews.text: Absolutely one of the best experiences ever with an auto shop. Didn’t try to over sell us or over charge us and even came in cheaper than their quote. Super friendly and easy to deal with. Got the work done quickly and right. Many would have taken advantage of my college daughter coming in for work on the car but they did not and even looked out for her. The only shop we will use in Sylva.

reviews.author: Dale
reviews.text: Jamie is the most experienced and honest mechanic I know. Prices are great and the work is top notch. He even fixed an issue that another shop in town had created when doing maintenance on my car. There's really no reason to visit anyone else. This is definitely the best auto shop in town.

reviews.author: Jay Foster
reviews.text: They picked up my Hyundai after it broke down on the road. The mechanic warned me upfront it would take about two weeks to even look at it but thankfully they got to it a week later and kept me updated as to the diagnosis and repair cost. My only complaint is the tow truck scratched my front bumper but overall I'm giving them five stars for the excellent service. The cost was acceptable also.

reviews.author: Jake Carver
reviews.text: We came from out of town and unfortunately our car started making a burning smell and putting off a little smoke from under the hood. We were .7 miles from C T Auto and within 30 mins they had us back on the road. Got an oil change before we left and they didn’t put the filter back on all the way. Thankfully no lasting issue. But they wouldn’t even charge me for fixing it, on the fly when we were in a little bit of panic mode 5 hrs from home with car troubles. I at least bought their lunch! Absolute stand up business with stand up people running it. Don’t hesitate to give them a call. I’m sure if they can help you, they will.

reviews.author: Abdu Annahas
reviews.text: Got a estimate range for a simple job over the phone. Was told to bring it in for it to be looked at and verified that that was the problem which it was. Car was fixed and ready to go the same day. Great and fast service.

reviews.author: Dorothy Hoche
reviews.text: Needed a new starter , car was towed there. They replaced the starter and advised me to call the previous shop that replaced it 3 months earlier. I did and they refunded fully. CT charged me less than the previous shop and I found all there to be friendly, courteous and had my best interest at heart. Also it is an extraordinarily CLEAN business. I would recommend them highly.

reviews.author: Daniel Holland
reviews.text: Besides being very friendly these gentlemen are very honest. Theybwill treat you right in your auto repairs. They check the parts before being installed and make sure they are top notch. If you in need of a good honest mechanic then these are you guys to go to.

reviews.author: Marie Hopkins
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing service & very reasonable priced! The mechanics and workers were very nice and the owner went out of his way to help when my card wasn't working. I would recommend this shop to anyone and if ever in town and need something fixed, I will be back.

reviews.author: Leysa Lambert
reviews.text: My son and I were attempting change his fuel filter and ran into a issue of not being able to put the filter on. Two gentleman from CT Auto came to our home and put the filter on and hooked up the two fuel lines for us but, most of all they didn't except any money. As a single mom it was a blessing just for that alone. Thank you so very much for helping us.

reviews.author: Monica lovesart
reviews.text: They couldn't figure out what was wrong with my car, so they didn't charge me for their assessment and sent me to the dealer. Turned out it was a recall issue that they could not have known about. Honest and humble. I'm a lifetime customer.

reviews.author: Joe S
reviews.text: We have used CT Auto for towing services twice. We had an excellent experience both times. I cannot speak for their mechanic work. I can only tell you that they were quicker, more professional, and better equipped to handle towing than competitors in the area. I will not use any other towing service in the area, especially after a different towing company damaged my vehicle and refused to take any responsibility. They know what they're doing here and that's what I like.

reviews.author: Julie Gentry
reviews.text: Way beyond honest! They charged far less than they could have, they did did some stuff free when they could’ve charged a small fee for it, plus I left my wallet on accident and not only did they call to let us know about it, but they stayed late (not long but it’s the point) so I could come get it!!! I’d recommend these people 24/7/365

reviews.author: Amber Cooper
reviews.text: I called to get a estimate to get my car fixed and they were the rudest people I have ever spoken to right from the start! They guy is a smart a** and is by no means out to help anyone! By the end of the phone call he was cussing and told me to take it to "some other idiot" to mess it up. Even if you know what your doing; you will get no where with the hateful rude customer service! I wouldn't advise a single person to take their vehicles there!

reviews.author: Savannah Bush
reviews.text: Do NOT I repeat do NOT have any auto repairs done at CT auto in Sylva. I took my car there to have a thermostat replaced out of necessity because no other shops in town could get it done before christmas, and I don't have the tools to do it myself. I provided my OWN part and they try to charge me $155 for a thermostat!!!!! All together it should be around $50-$70 and that is including the price of the part. Do not give them your business unless you want to get taken!!!!

reviews.author: donna wood
reviews.text: ZERO STARS!!! My daughter is a college student in the area and took her car there for an oil change. When she picked it up - price was 3 times what it was the previous times. This particular incident they rotated the tires - literally rotated the new tires from my daughters car to SOMEWHERE ELSE - And replaced with 2 bald tires that do not match the other tires. My daughter being young and inexperienced - didn't realize it until a few days later. Of course when confronted - they denied it. Not only do the tires not match - the wheels aren't the same. NEVER GET HER BUSINESS AGAIN - AND I'M NOT FINISHED WITH THEM YET!

reviews.author: Claudette Jeri
reviews.text: these are the best people I have ever met, helped me with my car that was broke down beside their shop.shout out to them

reviews.author: Hope Cabe
reviews.text: Locked my keys out of my car today (Sunday) & this man didn’t hesitate to help one bit!! He was quick & super nice! Huge thank you!!!

reviews.author: Gregory Noll
reviews.text: Top notch service. I will be back, if need be. Timely service. He even offered a free ride to my home so that I was not stranded.

reviews.author: Brian Hardt
reviews.text: Taken cars there three times. Fast service, problems explained well, no post repair problems. You do have to tease some answers and info out from them as they aren't the most talkative.

reviews.author: Gary Fleck
reviews.text: I was an out of towner passing through with electrical issues and they treated me with respect and kindness. Took time right then to get me back on the road.

reviews.author: Garland Bennett
reviews.text: We were on vacation and needed a brake job done. Call these guys up and the got us done by days end and we were ready to go. Local or from out of town, take your business their way.

reviews.author: Ronald Gibson
reviews.text: Extremely rude, extremely condescending, very arrogant will be filling a complaint with better business bureau, sylva chamber of commerce and the jackson county sheriffs office.

reviews.author: Jason Pearson
reviews.text: Nice man working helped push my stalled out car from the road even though the shop was full and he was quite busy. Thanks man!

reviews.author: Brian Rose
reviews.text: I agree with several of the other comments. Talked with the owner himself. Ditto on the same attitude
